raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions keeps 26 record_version=2 rows that supersede version-1 rows for the same txn_id, but silver_transactions keeps every version whose status is POSTED, so about 25 txn_ids appear twice. The fix is to keep only the latest record_version per txn_id before applying the POSTED filter. This assumes a later version supersedes the earlier one, including a REVERSED status, which I could not confirm because no v2 sample rows were shown.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": ["CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW txn_latest_version AS SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC) = 1"], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM txn_latest_version WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
